title: 2D LiDAR to Frozen ML Model Feature Compatibility Matrix
disclaimer: This value is NOT a physical 2D LiDAR measurement for all compatibility defaults.

features.derivation_method: Direct Euclidean range calculation: sqrt(x^2 + y^2) from LiDAR returns
features.risk_notes: Dominant risk factor. Highly reliable in planar scans.

features.derivation_method: Longitudinal coordinate (+X forward in vehicle frame: r * cos(theta))
features.risk_notes: Represents forward obstacle distance along truck centerline.

features.derivation_method: Lateral coordinate (+Y left in vehicle frame: r * sin(theta))
features.risk_notes: Dominant lateral factor determining whether obstacle is in haul truck travel corridor.

features.derivation_method: Nominal sensor mount plane default (0.0 m)
features.hardware_source: None (Elevation physically unavailable from single-plane 2D LiDAR)
features.compatibility_disclaimer: This value is NOT a physical 2D LiDAR measurement.
features.risk_notes: Frozen model assigns negative/negligible importance (-0.00134); default does not distort predictions.

features.derivation_method: Planar cross-sectional beam extremity span in sensor scan plane
features.hardware_source: Cluster geometry across contiguous beam returns
features.compatibility_disclaimer: Derived from 2D planar cluster bounding box.
features.risk_notes: Measures visible cross-section; occluded edges cannot be resolved in single 2D plane.

features.derivation_method: Nominal obstacle height baseline default (1.5 m)
features.hardware_source: None (Vertical extent physically unavailable from 2D planar LiDAR)
features.compatibility_disclaimer: This value is NOT a physical 2D LiDAR measurement.
features.risk_notes: Frozen model assigns negative/negligible importance (-0.00141); default does not distort predictions.

features.derivation_method: Radial beam depth span along cluster line of sight
features.hardware_source: Cluster depth range variation in 2D scan plane
features.compatibility_disclaimer: Derived from 2D planar cluster line-of-sight depth.
features.risk_notes: Trailing obstacle geometry is partially occluded in planar LiDAR returns.

features.derivation_method: Number of contiguous beam returns clustered into 2D obstacle
features.hardware_source: Count of valid 2D LaserScan range returns in cluster
features.risk_notes: Represents 2D planar beam density; proportional to distance and angular resolution.

features.hardware_source: Temporal association across consecutive 2D scan timestamps
features.risk_notes: High model importance (8.8%). Requires >= 2 cycles to initialize; defaults to 0.0 on cycle 1.

features.derivation_method: Vehicle CAN bus / wheel speed odometry / GNSS telemetry
features.hardware_source: Haul truck powertrain telemetry (external to LiDAR)
features.compatibility_disclaimer: External vehicle sensor input; configurable default 25.0 km/h used if telemetry absent.
features.risk_notes: Key kinetic risk factor (5.7%). In production, must be fed from truck CAN bus.

features.hardware_source: Calculated from 2D distance and 2D tracker closing velocity
features.compatibility_disclaimer: Derived from 2D distance and temporal tracking velocity.
features.risk_notes: Most important feature in frozen model (37.6%). Accurately computed from 2D planar kinematics.

features.hardware_source: None (Single 2D planar slice contour cannot perform semantic classification)
features.compatibility_disclaimer: This value is NOT a physical 2D LiDAR measurement.
features.risk_notes: Classification importance is negligible (<1%). Model remains primarily kinematic-driven.
